theorems.name: Submission.cmcs_smi_lintegral_left_dini_le
theorems.statement: ∀ (F : ℝ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ), Monotone F → ∫⁻ t in Ioo a b, liminf (fun h : ℝ => ENNReal.ofReal ((F t - F (t - h)) / h)) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (F b - F a)
